stories.result: Searching Replicate for 'flux' now renders 42 of 250 models with zero page errors; nullable fields no longer crash filtering.
Testing Catalog renders 360 articles and 10 tag choices (All Tags plus 9 real categories) with no failed catalog requests or error banner.
The functional deployed route is /dashboard?section=<id>, but the app still copies origin-root /?section=<id>. Opening the generated root URL returns an empty body with zero sections.
Plain Share still copies https://ai-model-analysis-dashboard.adamholter.chatgpt.site/?section=llms instead of preserving /dashboard. Filtered shared-view creation itself returns HTTP 200.
Shared-view storage remains operational, but the recipient URL construction still targets the blank origin root, so the copied UI link cannot reach dashboard restoration.

The Agent opens on an empty live-data question surface with no demo/sample answer, mock output, placeholder response, or promotional/demo banner. Visible copy explicitly says source failures are reported instead of being replaced with sample output.

discovered_errors.title: Generated direct/share links still omit the deployed /dashboard pathname
discovered_errors.evidence: Production v12 Share copied https://ai-model-analysis-dashboard.adamholter.chatgpt.site/?section=llms; loading that exact URL rendered an empty body and zero sections, while /dashboard?section=llms works.
discovered_errors.expected: Build section and shared-view URLs from the current dashboard pathname (or make the root route redirect while preserving query parameters).
